svg.title: A ray samples more than the clock rate
svg.desc: A light ray bends toward a mass relative to its straight incoming reference line; the impact parameter is marked. This is the shape from a first-order weak-field deflection profile, with its amplitude enlarged. The book derives why keeping only the clock term misses half the leading GR deflection.

g.text: 24 / A RAY SAMPLES MORE THAN THE CLOCK RATE
Both clock and spatial terms affect light
A weak-field ray past a spherical mass; deflection exaggerated.

svg.data-tex: b\text{ is the impact parameter in the weak-field, asymptotically flat description.}
svg.aria-label: b is the impact parameter in the weak-field, asymptotically flat description.
